# Incremental Reconciliation

The reconcile function processes merged pull requests and direct commits that have occurred after a specified timestamp. This function ensures that changes are individually compiled and reconciled with existing data, thereby facilitating efficient version control and update handling.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
